name: cpp-itk
description: Native compute skills — modern C++ style and static analysis, target-based CMake with presets and ITK/elastix dependencies across macOS/Windows/Linux, ITK pipelines (smart pointers, image geometry, DICOM series IO, transform conventions vs DICOM registration objects, threading, determinism), a command-line worker contract for Node job runners, and native unit/regression testing. Depends on `core`.
